name: OpenGUI
description: Control locally connected Android phones and monitor a private device wall from WorkBuddy.
description_zh: 通过 WorkBuddy 操作本机连接的 Android 手机，并在只读设备墙中查看最多四台手机的画面。
description_en: Control locally connected Android phones from WorkBuddy and monitor up to four phones in a read-only device wall.
examples_zh: 看看手机上的 Android 版本
在设备墙里查看这两台手机的画面
examples_en: Check the Android version on my phone
Show these two phones in the device wall
